svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 countries ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit GGY (Bailiwick of Guernsey: Guernsey, Alderney, Sark, Herm, Jethou); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth.
